column1: # Not synonyms: these are the SAME term written differently.  Three kinds, each
# of which silently costs Exact Match a point when the textbook picks one form
# and the student picks the other (PLAN.md §9):
#   english   English<->Bangla technical term      CO2 / কার্বন ডাই-অক্সাইড
#   compound  space, hyphen or sandhi difference   সালোকসংশ্লেষণ / সালোক সংশ্লেষণ
#   translit  transliteration spelling variant     অক্সিজেন / অক্সিজেন্
# Digit variants (১৯৭১ / 1971) are NOT listed here: normalize() folds Bengali
# digits to ASCII for every string in the project, so they can never diverge.
